scheme_name: Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme
other_conditions: Applicant’s name must be present in the family card
Family is defined as the eligible member, their legal spouse, their children, and their dependent parents
benefits_summary: Provides cashless hospitalization with coverage up to Rs. 5,00,000 per family per year.
documents_required: income certificate issued by the VAO/Revenue Authorities
self‑declaration from the head of the family
